## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm verify`
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e`
- [ ] `pnpm audit --prod`
- [ ] Documentation updated when behavior or configuration changed

## Security and data

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, databases, runtime state, or workspace contents are included
- [ ] Authentication, Origin checks, IPC roles, and allowed-root behavior remain intact
